patterns.message: The generation engine must not depend on MCP. Adapters live in src/mcp.

no-restricted-properties.message: The engine must be deterministic: identical requests produce identical bytes. Take a timestamp in the adapter and pass it in if one is genuinely needed.
The engine must be deterministic. Derive any varying value from the request instead.
The engine must be deterministic. Measure in the adapter or in tests, not in generation.
Reading the environment makes output depend on where the server was started. Pass configuration in as an argument.

no-restricted-globals.name: process
no-restricted-globals.message: The engine must not depend on the host process. Aliasing it defeats the no-restricted-properties guard, so the global itself is off limits outside src/engine/verify.

no-restricted-globals.name: performance
no-restricted-globals.message: The engine must be deterministic. Measure in the adapter or in tests, not in generation.
